summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose its disclosure of daily stock repurchase transactions to the Australian Securities Exchange, as required by ASX rules. The $1 billion stock buyback program was previously authorized and this report is a periodic disclosure of repurchase activity. No price/share, premium, or board recommendation is mentioned. The filing does not announce a new special situation; it is a routine update on an existing capital return program. What to watch: Continued buyback execution under the program.
